## FAQ

-   **How often does the data update?**

    -   Most dashboards update within 10–15 minutes of a new response. Learning assessments update after they're scored, and IPG Raw Data pulls live from Qualtrics. The FY27 Data Collection Tracker and Project Health sheet update every hour. Each card on the [Dashboards](Dashboards.qmd) page lists its refresh timing; the details are in [On the Data](On_the_data.qmd).

-   **Which school years are on here?**

    -   Current dashboards cover SY25-26 and SY26-27 (filter by date to see one year). Each card on the [Dashboards](Dashboards.qmd) page lists its years. Earlier years are in the [Archives](archives.qmd).

-   **Something looks wrong or missing.**

    -   Reach out to the Learning & Research team with the dashboard link and the filters you used.
